vitals.label: Core Web Vitals for the range (75th percentile)

vitals.clsHint: Cumulative Layout Shift: how much the page content moves while it loads, unitless.
vitals.inpHint: Interaction to Next Paint: how long the page takes to respond visibly to a click, tap or key press.

service.invalidId: This ID doesn't have the format of a Dynatrace service (SERVICE- and 16 hexadecimal characters): its data isn't requested.

metricSetNote.activity: This service type only measures activity
metricSetNote.activityHint: Dynatrace only counts the requests of this service type: there are no response times or errors.
metricSetNote.clientHint: Times, requests and errors come from the client metrics: what the callers of this service measure.
metricSetNote.unifiedHint: Times, requests and errors come from the Dynatrace unified metrics; the error rate is calculated from the failed requests and the total.
metricSetNote.fallbackHint: The type of this service could not be read (for example, the token lacks entities.read), so the server metrics are used.

availability.title: Availability (calculated SLO)
availability.hint: Availability = (Requests − Errors) / Requests × 100, per point and for the range. Vigía calculates it from the requests and errors of this service: it is not an SLO configured in Dynatrace (those are on Home). Below 90% is critical.
